story_type: lunar probe sends pictures all the way down until it crashes into the moon
hook: This camera kept filming until it slammed into the moon.
narration: This camera kept sending pictures home until it slammed into the moon.
It was a NASA Ranger probe, launched from Cape Kennedy in 1965.
Its pictures had to prove the moon had ground smooth enough to land on.
Ranger never slowed down. It kept shooting and radioing pictures home as it fell.
In the final seconds, the frames came in from closer and closer.
outcome: The world watched on television as Ranger approached and hit the moon.
title: Camera filmed until it hit the moon
description:
A NASA Ranger probe launched from Cape Kennedy in 1965 sent back pictures of the moon until impact, showing areas smooth enough for a landing. The world watched on television as it approached and hit the moon.
